about.summary: Software engineer with experience building distributed telemetry, cloud APIs, internal developer tools, and full-stack products. I enjoy solving systems problems and turning complex technical requirements into reliable, maintainable software.

experience.role: Software Engineer Intern - Network Detection & Response
highlights: Designed and implemented a distributed telemetry service in Haskell on NixOS/Linux network security appliances, publishing health and configuration data to Kafka for automated misconfiguration detection, remediation, and capacity-aware bandwidth allocation.

Engineered a least-privilege authorization model for a cloud-based network appliance management and SSH access portal using Amazon Cognito and hierarchical customer and appliance policies in DynamoDB.
Migrated six AWS API Gateway endpoints from direct DynamoDB integrations to AWS Lambda, enabling fine-grained Cognito authorization and supporting future PostgreSQL and HTTP v2 API migrations.
Prototyped Go REST APIs for routing IoT events and AWS Systems Manager updates to downstream microservices.
Designed and tested a SQLite data layer and supported the database selection decision.
Reduced documentation time by 90% per release by building Python CLI tools that gathered software version information from GitLab, Artifactory, and Jira.
Integrated tooling into Jenkins CI with more than 95% unit test coverage.
Worked in a team of four to build a full-stack HR onboarding platform supporting more than 200 new hires, delivering 8 REST APIs and 5 frontend views with React and Spring Boot.
Improved employee and task API response times by 40% through PostgreSQL query optimization and Redis caching.

projects.title: Distributed MapReduce Framework
projects.summary: A fault-tolerant MapReduce system with concurrent scheduling and speculative execution.
highlights: Implemented a coordinator-worker MapReduce system in Go using RPC.
Built concurrent task scheduling with goroutines and channels, including automatic reassignment when workers fail.
Added speculative execution for straggling tasks to improve overall job completion time.

projects.title: Repo2Resume
projects.subtitle: WPI 2025 Hackathon Winner
projects.summary: An AI-powered resume generator that transforms GitHub repositories into tailored STAR-format resume bullets.
highlights: Built a full-stack application with a React and Tailwind frontend and a FastAPI backend.
Used PineconeDB embeddings and semantic search to match repositories with relevant job descriptions.

projects.title: Database Systems Projects
projects.summary: Core database components covering buffer management, indexing, and query planning.
highlights: Implemented a DBMS buffer manager with frame allocation, LRU eviction, and pin/unpin semantics.
Built indexing structures that reduced query lookup from O(n) scans to O(1) access.
Developed a SQL-like query engine that selects between table and index scans based on query characteristics.
